status: PROPOSAL · prepared for the KFB Open World integration slice · not accepted by any Open World owner
determinism: derive(seed, path) = FNV-1a(`${seed}|g${GEN_VERSION}|${path}`) · GEN_VERSION 1 · same seed + version → same IDs (checks T1–T4)

currentApi.createGen(seed): → { seed, type, P, settlement, near, toLocal, toWorld, townR, owner, road, height, ground, block, recipe, chunkRecipe, streetIds, vegDensity }
currentApi.compileChunk(gen, cx, cz, lod, damage, h: → { pos, nrm, col, idx (typed arrays), inst{win,door,chim,trunk,crown}, meta, recipes }

proposedApi.createGen(seed, { heightAt?, overrides?: heightAt(x,z) injected by the Open World terrain owner; own bands remain the fallback

overrides.suppressParcels: string[] parcel ids not to build

proposedApi.streetSplines(gen): → [{ id, kind: 'primary'|'secondary'|'path', pts: [[x,z],…], width }] as RouteRecipe input for Track Core

pattern.rings: Chebyshev rings on 64 m chunks: ≤1 LOD0 · 2 LOD1 · 3 LOD2 · 4–5 LOD3 · release at 7 · 121 slots
pattern.pipeline: request → worker compile (≤3 in flight) → result queue sorted by ring → integrate ≤3 per frame while frame integration time < budgetMs (default 4)
pattern.fallback: module worker → blob module worker → one main-thread compile per frame
pattern.staleResults: dropped when seed or job generation changed

chunkStreamer.proposedApi: createChunkStreamer({ compile(job) → transferable result, integrate(result, slot), release(slot), ringOf(cx,cz), budgetMs, maxPerFrame }) → { update(x,z), pending(), stats }

record.bits: base64 of 2-bit cell states: 0 intact · 1 damaged · 2 gone

damageState.rule: reconstruct = recipe + bits; no mesh stored

profile.carryLayer: upper body from Running_HoldingRifle (chest subtree), gun aligned along its barrel axis to the aim point, blended on land/take-off

locomotionModes.rule: exactly one locomotion writer per mode (matches WB0 runtime-mode.js)

states.flight: Space/↑ climb · ↓ descend · ground contact → walk
states.walk: Space jump → air · Space×2 ≤ 0.3 s or ↑ → flight

locomotionModes.transitionNote: Open World accepted Travel TMB-2 ground↔flight at 400 ms; align fades to it

cameraRule.rule: chase camera rigid in the actor frame; on occlusion the boom shortens, never lifts; minimum 70 % of boom length so the actor stays fully in frame; only boom length is smoothed

rules: Meta held → clear all keys (macOS drops keyup)
re-read mouse buttons from e.buttons on every move
pointer lock only while a button is held

supportSurfaceRegistration.targetApi: createSupportSurfaceResolver().registerObject(id, object, { kind, roles, recipeId, maxRise, minUpDot })
supportSurfaceRegistration.proposal: flat roofs (roof.type 'flat') and intact slab cells register as kind 'roof', roles ['support','walkable'], recipeId = building id

raidPortal.targetSeam: Combat Raid + Open World sprint 5 (portal/entry record)
